name: embla-carousel
title: Embla Carousel
responsibility: Carousel and horizontal-scroll mechanics — dragging, snapping, momentum. Nothing visual.
reachFor: Image galleries, product showcases, testimonial rails
Hero carousels and horizontal content strips
avoid: Vertical page-scroll effects (that is Lenis/GSAP ScrollTrigger territory)
Marquees — an infinite CSS/motion loop is lighter than a carousel
Custom visual chrome — Embla ships zero DOM styling; the design is ours
inRepo: 16 presets already build on it (embla-chip-rail, embla-masthead-hero, embla-logo-wall, …)
